dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to upload and publish or schedule YouTube videos via Publora, and the examples match that purpose by creating a post, getting an upload URL, and uploading video bytes. This can affect a real YouTube channel, but the behavior is direct and disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The examples use placeholder API keys, channel IDs, filenames, descriptions, and scheduled times. They do not include a strong confirmation step or set privacy explicitly in the sample requests, so users should review those values before running code.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only SKILL.md documentation. There are no executables, install scripts, background services, or bundled code that would run automatically.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use of a Publora API key and outbound requests to api.publora.com and a returned upload URL is proportionate for a video publishing integration. The only local file access shown is reading a named video file for upload.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The workflow can schedule future posts and the documentation states that YouTube privacy defaults to public. That is purpose-aligned, but users should explicitly choose privacy and scheduling settings.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The concern about transmitting video files, descriptions, filenames, and metadata externally is supported by the examples, but this is the core function of a Publora YouTube upload skill and is visibly documented.
[SQP-2] expected: The public privacy default is present in the artifact and is guidance-worthy because it could expose content if users omit privacy settings, but it is disclosed and not hidden or deceptive.
llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an agent to help publish or schedule YouTube videos through Publora. Keep the Publora API key private, verify the video file, channel ID, title or description, scheduled time, and privacy setting, and avoid uploading sensitive or unreleased media unless publication is intended.
llm.summary: This skill is a documentation-only guide for uploading and scheduling YouTube videos through Publora, with expected external upload behavior and no hidden execution components.
